findings.finding: The new withdrawal branch requires paidRecovery=true, so its outer HTTP guard still applies assertMetaMaskReadinessRequest. That guard rejects Ethereum sendTransaction/sendRawTransaction, including the intended exact refund. The new provider-level guard alone does not resolve this conflicting boundary.
findings.verification: Read-only evaluation of the actual extracted guard rejects both send methods. Current new tests exercise provider admission without the outer HTTP guard.
findings.repair: Compose an exact original refund-only admission at the outer boundary and exercise it with existing provider/HTTP guards. Preserve rejection of funding, other calldata/recipient/nonces and duplicate sends; no broad send-method exception.

findings.finding: Refund traffic counts remain page-owned and finalizePrivateRecovery executes before context.close. Late denied wallet operations during teardown are not included in the final pass/fail result. The release branch similarly invokes finalizePaid immediately and omits it from the after-close finalizer.
findings.repair: Retain a bounded Node-owned denied/send observation and check after context close, preserving the existing original provider result/failure. Carry release finalizePaid into the existing finalizer.

findings.finding: No-post guard names PluginReplied; actual decoder emits PluginReplyPublished. Worker self-identified this literal defect.
findings.repair: Use actual event type and retain a negative for its presence.

otherAssessment: Separate schema2 release/withdraw approvals retain exact runtime/public scope, budget and fee caps, expiry and private input/export hashes. No new proof flag or production crypto override.
Release exercises authorization export/reload, exact workflow digest, cancellation of first review, re-review and one release send with canonical accounting; no publish-post step.

Refund provider guard reserves its one attempt before asynchronous reads, binds original encrypted Ethereum journal and withdrawal amount/recipient/exit nonce/calldata/gas cap, and refuses uncertain replay. These local properties are useful but do not cure the composed-boundary findings.
Existing complete uniform accounting and private owner filtering are reused; partial balances are not accepted.
tests: Eight focused controlled cases pass; earlier broad100pass+twoenvironment failures repaired separately, one existing browser opt-in skip. No whole105 or live release/withdrawal claim.
